entries.what: ZoomInfo's own hosted server. Searches companies, contacts, intent and news, and enriches them. Enrich tools use data credits and the research tools are billed as AI actions.

steps.label: Add the server to Claude Code

manual: Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http zoominfo --scope user https://mcp.zoominfo.com/mcp
In Claude Code run /mcp, pick zoominfo and sign in in the browser. Or run: claude mcp login zoominfo
Codex: codex mcp add zoominfo --url https://mcp.zoominfo.com/mcp
Then sign in: codex mcp login zoominfo
You need a ZoomInfo licence.
ZoomInfo forbids using data reached this way to train AI models. Switch model training off in your AI account first.

entries.name: Zotero MCP
entries.what: Lets an agent search a Zotero library, read item metadata, full text and PDF pages, read and create annotations and notes, add papers by DOI, URL, ISBN or file, and manage collections and tags.

manual: Set ZOTERO_LOCAL as the source says.
Install first with uv tool install zotero-mcp-server (or pip); Python 3.10+
You need: The Zotero desktop app, version 7 or later, running with its local API switched on in Settings, Advanced
Claude Code: claude mcp add --env ZOTERO_LOCAL=<your value> --transport stdio --scope user zotero -- zotero-mcp
Codex: codex mcp add zotero --env ZOTERO_LOCAL=<your value> -- zotero-mcp

Read only mode: No named switch. The README calls writes optional: they need `zotero-mcp authorize-local` on Zotero 10 or later, or `ZOTERO_API_KEY` and `ZOTERO_LIBRARY_ID` on older Zotero. Leaving that step out keeps it to reads.
